description: The SDLC pipeline as a DAG rather than a fixed array. This is what lets review and test genuinely run in parallel — the skill protocol always described that, but a flat array could not do it.

analyze.description: Trace data flow, identify every file that changes, map dependencies.

implement.description: Implement following repo conventions; apply best practices; avoid known anti-patterns.

review.description: Score 0-100. Conventions, edge cases, security, tests.

test.description: Unit and integration tests with edge-case coverage.

deploy.description: PR description, CI readiness, release notes.

humanGateProtocol.mechanism: The phase writes a review artifact, then stops. A Stop hook refuses to let the session end while a gate artifact exists with no matching verdict file. The verdict is written either by the view plane's gate panel or by `python scripts/pipeline.py approve <pipelineId> <phase>`.
humanGateProtocol.why: A gate whose entire implementation is a toast notification is a request, not a gate. Blocking Stop on a verdict file uses the same insight as the fact-forcing gate: own the action stream, not the generation stream.
